_meta.description: Minimum viable intake checklist. Validated by scaffold/validate-intake.js before any intake is committed to GitHub.

mandatory.label: Named systems
mandatory.description: At least one source system AND one target system must be identifiable by name (e.g. Salesforce, NetSuite, SAP, a database name, an API name).
mandatory.failMessage: No system names found. We need to know what systems are being integrated before we can proceed.

mandatory.label: Business problem or pain point
mandatory.description: The documents must describe WHAT is broken, slow, manual, or at risk today — not just what the solution should do.
mandatory.failMessage: No business problem identified. Without understanding the pain point, the architect cannot make the right integration pattern choice.

mandatory.label: Data flow direction
mandatory.description: At least one data flow must be described: what data moves, from where, to where, and roughly when (real-time / batch / triggered).
mandatory.failMessage: No data flow direction found. We need at least one source → target flow described to begin architecture.

recommended.label: Volume or frequency estimate
recommended.description: How many records per day/hour? How often does the integration need to run? Needed for NFR decisions.
recommended.missingImpact: Architect will default to medium volume / 99.9% availability. Confirm before go-live.

recommended.label: Go-live date or project deadline
recommended.description: Any stated deadline, sprint target, or go-live date.
recommended.missingImpact: No timeline constraint — architect will not factor urgency into complexity trade-offs.

recommended.label: API auth type or credentials hint
recommended.description: OAuth, API key, basic auth, SAML — any mention of how target systems are accessed.
recommended.missingImpact: Architect will flag all undocumented systems for API Contract Discovery. Adds 1-2 days per unknown system.

recommended.label: Non-functional requirements
recommended.description: Uptime SLA, latency expectations, data sensitivity / compliance requirements.
recommended.missingImpact: Architect defaults to internal security tier and 99.9% availability. Will ask if financial/regulated data involved.

recommended.label: Existing integrations or middleware
recommended.description: Does the client already have MuleSoft, an ESB, or point-to-point integrations? Avoids re-designing what exists.
recommended.missingImpact: Risk of duplicating existing work. Architect will ask.

recommended.label: Key stakeholders and decision-makers
recommended.description: Who approves architecture decisions? Who owns each system?
recommended.missingImpact: Open items may stall if no named owner per system.

autoWarnings.warning: NetSuite REST API requires PS256 JWT via Nimbus JOSE helper — the standard NetSuite connector does NOT support REST. Factor in an extra story for the JWT sub-flow.
SAP JCo connector requires a separate MuleSoft license AND native SAP JCo JARs. Confirm license status before scoping.
ServiceNow connector metadata does NOT work with OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code. Use basic auth for metadata resolution in Studio.
Oracle JDBC driver (ojdbc11.jar) cannot be declared in pom.xml due to Oracle licensing. Must be placed in shared lib folder on CloudHub 2.0.
Sub-second latency requirement detected. Verify downstream systems can respond within SLA before selecting request-reply pattern — SAP, NetSuite, and legacy ERPs often cannot.
Financial data detected. Compensating-transaction strategy is MANDATORY if any mutation can fail mid-flow. Architect must select process-orchestration (H) if 2+ systems mutate in the same flow.
PII or regulated data detected. Security tier must be 'regulated' or higher. Field encryption and data masking in logs are mandatory. Confirm compliance framework.
High-volume or data warehouse destination detected. Consider streaming-pipeline (L) or batch (C) pattern, NOT scheduled-sync (D) which is capped at ~10K records per run.

autoWarnings.trigger: existing mulesoft|already have mulesoft|current mulesoft|mulesoft instance|anypoint platform
autoWarnings.warning: Client may have existing MuleSoft assets. Check for reusable System APIs, shared connectors, and existing commons libraries before generating new scaffold.

autoWarnings.trigger: idp|intelligent document|document processing|document extraction|invoice scan|invoice processing|pdf extract|pdf parsing|ocr|form digitization|contract extraction|anypoint idp
autoWarnings.warning: Anypoint IDP (Intelligent Document Processing) detected. IDP has no dedicated Mule connector — it is called via HTTP connector against the Anypoint Platform IDP REST API. The call is async: POST execution → poll GET until COMPLETED (default 10 attempts × 3s = 30s timeout). Auth: Anypoint Connected App (OAuth 2.0 client credentials). Required intake: (1) IDP action ID + version ID from Anypoint IDP UI, (2) Anypoint org ID, (3) document source type (HTTP upload / S3 / SFTP / email attachment), (4) output entity name and target system. Budget one story for the IDP sub-flow + one story for the DataWeave result mapping. Add an IDP manual-review queue — all failed extractions route there.

autoWarnings.trigger: d365|dynamics 365|dynamics fo|finance and operations|d365 fo|dynamics finance
autoWarnings.warning: D365 Finance & Operations connector does NOT support PATCH on OData entities (FK-005). Any update operation requires a raw HTTP PATCH with manually managed OAuth token (fetch, cache in ObjectStore at 55-min TTL, evict on 401) plus If-Match ETag header. Budget 1-2 extra story points per flow that writes to D365 FO.

HubSpot search API uses cursor-based pagination (paging.next.after). Mule 4 has no native while-loop — use recursive sub-flow under 1,000 records, batch scope with page-aware iterator above that (FK-006). Also: webhook flows (e.g. contact.merge) require Professional tier or higher and must always return HTTP 200 — non-2xx triggers HubSpot retry storms (FK-008).

Shopify connector has partial coverage for fulfillment write operations (FK-005). If the project requires updating fulfillment status or tracking in Shopify, raw HTTP calls with a manual token sub-flow will be needed. Also: Shopify tag updates replace the entire tag string — MuleSoft must read-merge-write to avoid deleting non-integration tags.

Spiff (Sales Performance Management) has no confirmed MuleSoft native connector as of 2026-05-11. Integration requires HTTP connector via Spiff REST API. Confirm API availability, auth type, and sandbox access before architecture begins. This is a scope blocker.

Mailchimp connector (mule4-mailchimp-marketing-connector v1.0) is a low-version connector — verify operation coverage on Anypoint Exchange before committing. Per FK-013 pattern, registry entries and actual connector operation coverage can diverge for recently added connectors. Confirm: list member add/update, tag management, audience sync, and webhook subscription are all supported. If partial — fall back to HTTP connector with API key auth.

No MuleSoft connector exists for WordPress or Gravity Forms. Integration via inbound HTTP webhook (Gravity Forms Webhook Add-On — requires Developer or Elite license) or outbound HTTP polling (WordPress REST API). Confirm Webhook Add-On is installed before committing to Pattern J (webhook-ingestion); fall back to Pattern D (scheduled-sync) if not.

autoWarnings.trigger: hd portal|home depot|hdportal|home depot service center
autoWarnings.warning: HD Portal (Home Depot Service Center) has no MuleSoft native connector — use HTTP connector with API key auth. CRITICAL: GET operations confirmed but WRITE endpoints (POST/PATCH) not tested as of 2026-05-11. Document download endpoint (299A/299B PDFs) not confirmed. API access requires coordination through the client's HD partner contact — not self-service. Confirm write endpoint availability before scoping any Salesforce→HD Portal flow. See standards/playbooks/hd-portal/hd-portal_playbook.json.

ComputerEase (Deltek) has no MuleSoft native connector — use HTTP connector. CRITICAL BLOCKER: API routes through CE Live Service (a Deltek routing service that must be installed on the client's VM) — NOT directly internet-accessible. CE Live Service must be configured by Deltek support before any development begins. API is NOT available in sandbox (P3) — production API only, requiring strict access guardrails. Budget extra time for Deltek support coordination. See standards/playbooks/computerease/computerease_playbook.json.

New system — PharmacyHub has no MuleSoft native connector. Integration is SFTP file-based (Pattern E). Confirm: SFTP server host/auth, file format (CSV/XML/other), file naming convention, processing frequency, and Salesforce target object before architecture. File format unknown is a blocker for DataWeave design.

New system — Pipeline Medical has no MuleSoft native connector. Integration is SFTP file-based (Pattern E). Separate flow from PharmacyHub — no-combine rule applies even if SFTP server is shared. Confirm: file format, naming convention, and whether it matches PharmacyHub structure.
